title: FedPref：面向结构化放射学报告提取的联邦偏好学习
summary: FedPref 是一种联邦学习方法，利用冻结的公共语言模型生成候选 JSON 提取，由本地标注排序，各机构仅共享模型更新，协作训练紧凑的 Qwen3-8B 适配器。在模拟数据上，相比独立训练，客户端平均 F1 提升 2.49 点，最差站点提升 9.10 点，且无需共享报告或标注。
summary_en: FedPref is a federated learning method that uses frozen public language models to propose candidate JSON extractions, ranked by local annotations, and collaboratively trains compact Qwen3-8B adapters while sharing only model updates. On simulated data, it improves client-mean F1 by 2.49 points and worst-site F1 by 9.10 points over isolated training, without sharing reports or annotations.
